title: Threat registry (mechanical entities the waves spawn, §2)
description: Shape of packages/content/threats/*.json. Structural shell for the §8.18 visual-coverage law (OD-12(d), ADR-0013 ruling 5d: every entry carries a `visual` slug or an explicit codexOnly tag) and the §2.4 lookalike law (OD-18, ADR-0013 ruling 9: optional `lookalikeOf` names the visitor archetype the threat masquerades as). Deep laws — coverage OR-tag, lookalike resolution against visitors/archetypes-core.json, one mimic-seed per shipped bundle, legacy required keys, Second-Answer counters — live in script/validate.mjs. Interpreter subset in use: type, required, properties, items, enum, pattern, minimum, maxItems.
